address.id: Park 23 XXI, Denpasar. Titik uji sementara buat nyoba alur sidequest "Catur Muka" tanpa harus ke lokasi aslinya — cerita/lore di sidequest ini tetap tentang Catur Muka, cuma koordinatnya dipindah ke sini buat testing.
address.en: Park 23 XXI, Denpasar. A temporary test point for trying the "Catur Muka" sidequest without traveling to the real site — the sidequest's story stays about Catur Muka, only the coordinate is moved here for testing.
